sentences.en: Zamenhof, creator of the constructed language Esperanto, was an ophthalmologist.
sentences.zh: 津巴多夫斯基，世界辅助语言埃斯珀兰托的创造者，是一名眼科医生。

sentences.en: Christians believe that God is the creator of the world.
sentences.zh: 基督徒认为上帝是这个世界（万物）的创造者。

sentences.en: There must be a creator who made all of this.
sentences.zh: 必须有一个创造了这一切的造物主。
